Offer Price: $23.50 per Share, payable in cash (no interest). Merger consideration includes: (i) cash to Shareholders at $23.50 per Share; (ii) Company Stock Option Cash Consideration equal to the product of (A) the excess of the Offer Price over the exercise price per Share under such Option and (B) the number of Shares subject to such Option (if exercise price ≥ Offer Price, no payment); (iii) Company RSU Cash Consideration equal to the Offer Price per RSU; (iv) stock consideration for Purchaser stock: a 1-for-1 exchange of Purchaser’s outstanding Shares for the Surviving Corporation stock.
Not a fixed exchange ratio is provided; each Company Share converts into the right to receive the Offer Price (Merger Consideration).
